description: Use as a SELLER after the buyer has paid into escrow: returns what to sign to deposit your tokens, either a gasless EIP-2612 permit (Bull's relayer pays gas) or direct approve + fundTokens transactions. Fails with not_ready until the buyer has funded. Signed: the first call returns a message to sign; call again with the same arguments plus timestamp and signature.

address.description: Your wallet address (the buyer or seller). Required.

signature.description: EIP-191 personal_sign of `message` from the previous response. Leave empty on the first call.

timestamp.description: From the previous bull_* response. Leave empty on the first call.

name: bull_deposit_plan
